name: SiD Corp MCP
description: SiD Corp is the central hub for automated print-on-demand, trusted by 2,000+ sellers running shops on Etsy, Amazon, TikTok Shop, and Shopify. This connector brings DodgePrint's Etsy intelligence directly into Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SiD Corp MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SiD Corp MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api-v2.dodgeprint.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SiD Corp MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SiD Corp MCP provides these MCP tools: Analyze competition, Benchmark listing, Explore niche, Find niche hidden gems, Find shared keywords, How to use, Plan seasonal calendar, Research keyword, Research shop, Scout new winners, Scout opportunities, and Suggest tags.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SiD Corp MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to SiD Corp MCP in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does SiD Corp MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: SiD Corp MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
SiD Corp MCP is developed by DodgePrint. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
